Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - elevated ELB target failures and ENI API 429s observed in us-west-1a. Severity assigned: P1. Paging infra-oncall.
Jules (infra-oncall): Acknowledged. What's the blast radius? app-serving only or control plane too?
Maya (sre): Metrics: rtx-web ELB target failure rate +230% from instances in us-west-1a. CloudTrail shows repeated CreateNetworkInterface calls returning 429/Throttling in that AZ over the last 8m.
Sam (networking): We're seeing ENI attach latency spike and AttachNetworkInterface API rate-limited for us-west-1a hosts. VPC flow logs show successful packets but frequent reattachments. No similar pattern in us-west-1b/c.
Jules (infra-oncall): Can someone dump the failing instance IDs and ELB target groups? Need to file with AWS.
Sam (networking): Pasting sample query and output (sanitized):
```
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters "Name=availability-zone,Values=us-west-1a" --query 'NetworkInterfaces[?Status==`impaired` || Status==`detaching`].{ID:NetworkInterfaceId,Attach:Attachment.InstanceId,Status:Status}'
# sample: eni-0a1b2c3d (attached -> detached rapidly), eni-0f9e8d7c (impaired)
```
Maya (sre): ELB logs show healthchecks passing then failing mid-connection. Sample:
```
[2026-03-15T03:12:02Z] elb=rtx-web tg=web-tg-1 target=i-0ff12abc health=healthy -> 502 after 16s
[2026-03-15T03:13:10Z] elb=rtx-web target=i-0ff12abc detach_reason=eni-detach
```
Jules (infra-oncall): Impact: preliminary mapping indicates ~12% of our API capacity for the region sits on affected instances. Some enterprise customers on pinned deployments experiencing errors.
Eli (eng-oncall): Joining. Proposed short-term mitigations: (1) move critical customer DNS entries to failover records pointing to us-west-2, (2) enable cross-zone load balancing to divert traffic away from AZ-local targets, (3) drain suspect instances from TGs.
Sam (networking): Agreed. I'm opening an AWS support case with details. Case #9876543210. Requesting ENI attach API quota increase/escalation and AZ host-nic health check.
Support Bot: Preparing impacted-customer snapshot now. Will post obfuscated list (account hashes) and affected endpoints in 3m.
Jules (infra-oncall): I'll coordinate DNS changes for the critical customers only. We should avoid global failover until we confirm recovery. Prepare rollback instructions.
Maya (sre): Canary plan: after DNS failover for a subset, watch user-facing errors and traces for those accounts. Increasing SLO alerting sensitivity for them.
Eli (eng-oncall): Executing ELB TG drain for identified instances. Command:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-1:123456:targetgroup/web-tg/xyz --targets Id=i-0ff12abc
```
Eli (eng-oncall): Also toggling cross-zone load balancing on relevant ELBs to prefer healthy AZs.
Sam (networking): AWS support replied: "We observe ENI API throttling in us-west-1a impacting EC2 attachment lifecycle. Investigating underlying host control-plane. Recommend shifting traffic and draining instances; escalation to networking team underway."
Jules (infra-oncall): Good. Sam, attach the CloudTrail snippets and instance logs to the case.
Sam (networking): Done. Uploaded logs and flow samples.
Support Bot: Impact report ready. Top affected: 8 medium customers, 3 enterprise customers, total ~14% of region traffic routed through impaired AZ backends.
Maya (sre): After partial DNS failover for enterprise set, error rate for those accounts dropped from ~20% to ~3% within 4 minutes. Metrics link: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz
Eli (eng-oncall): Leaving weighted failover in place for the enterprise customers only. Rolling config ID: Z3CONFIG-20260315-1. We'll monitor for 30m before further rollbacks.
Jules (infra-oncall): Handoff: my pager rotation starts now. Eli, you own incident until my next overlap. Make sure we have an incident bridge and note for the postmortem.
Eli (eng-oncall): Taking over. Creating bridge: meet.link/incident-2140012345. Inviting networking, SRE, support, and AWS liaison.
Incident Bot: P1 call scheduled at 2140012400. Paging #incident-p1 and #sre-oncall.
AWS Support Bot: Case #9876543210 updated: assigned to NetService-APAC-USWest team; ETA preliminary findings in 20 minutes.
Maya (sre): Quick note: enable request tracing for 5% sample on affected customer accounts to collect root cause data.
Support Bot: Drafting customer notice for enterprise customers: includes summary, mitigation steps (traffic shifted to us-west-2), ETA unknown pending AWS fix. Will send after review.
Sam (networking): Observed partial normalization in ENI attach latency but still elevated error responses. I'll keep the case active and request priority escalation if not resolved within 30m.
Eli (eng-oncall): Logging timeline entries in the incident tracker and tagging as "networking-eni-throttle-usw1a". Will update channel on any AWS confirmation or full recovery.
Jules (infra-oncall): Thanks team. I'll remain available via DM while off-rotation. :slightly_smiling_face:
Incident Bot: Last update at 2140012589 - mitigation in place for critical customers, regional AZ degradation ongoing, AWS investigating. Next scheduled update in 15m or on significant change.
